title: qcr --schema 3 board, board family version 1
description: The reviewer's board for a host that runs it for its operator: who posts and where, whether the reviewer works, and three short lists of pull requests. An absent field means unknown, never zero, an empty list or a default; an empty list is a read that found nothing. With the daemon off the three lists are absent. No field carries a URL: a host builds its links from its own record of the repository and the numbers here. The verb reads and never writes.

schema_version.description: The host contract the payload is printed in. A host-family payload leads with its contract's number, not with the family's own version (which names this file).

written_at.description: When the daemon wrote the board the lists, poll, spend and posting are read from, ISO. Absent with them.

repo.description: The configured repository, owner/name. Absent before setup.

mode.description: How the reviewer posts: as a person, as a GitHub App it holds the key of, or as an App installation whose token its host supplies.

login.description: The login reviews are posted under.

identity.description: Who posts, as the config says. Absent until the config names an identity.

posting.description: The running daemon's own flag: dry_run records each intended GitHub write and posts nothing.

posting_pending.description: The config says live and the running daemon is still in dry-run: it posts once it has restarted.

reviewer.description: off: the daemon does not run. starting: it runs and its first poll has not ended. on: its heartbeat and last poll are fresh and clean. paused_login: the model login it reviews on lapsed. broken: it runs and is not working.

model_login.description: The host's stored model login, from pi's own files. Readable before setup.

github.description: A host-managed GitHub token file, as the file and its expiry note say. Absent when the install has no such file or it cannot tell.

trigger_label.description: The label that makes the reviewer pick up a pull request by itself.

trigger.description: What the reviewer picks up by itself, as the install's config says it now (`[github] trigger`; a running daemon follows that key at every poll). label: pull requests that carry the trigger label. all: every open pull request that is not a draft and not the reviewer's own, each once, which spends model usage on every pull request. Absent when the config cannot be read or states neither.

last_at.description: When the last reconcile pass ran, ISO. Absent before the first pass has ended.

ok.description: That pass ran with no error. Absent before the first pass.

interval_s.description: The daemon's own poll cadence, in seconds.

today_unknown_rounds.description: Rounds today that used tokens and have no price: the sum counts none of them.

spend.description: What the daemon recorded as spent on model calls in the current UTC day and month.

reviewed_today.description: How many pull requests had a review round finish since midnight in the install's configured timezone ([ops] timezone): each pull request once, open or closed now, posted or practice. Counted by the daemon from its round store when it writes the board. Absent when the daemon is off, when it could not count (its store or its timezone could not be read), and once the day the count is of has ended: never zero by default.

proof.description: The practice review a go-live is confirmed against: the round the checklist records, once `qcr --schema 3 host proof-result` has returned it. Absent until then.

reviewing.description: Pull requests with review work owed or in flight: queued, a round running, a finished review being delivered, or a failure on record. Newest first.

reviewed.description: Open pull requests whose last verdict is set and that are not in reviewing. Newest first.

open.description: The open pull requests the last reconcile pass listed, minus the two lists above. Newest first. Absent until a pass has listed them.

listed_at.description: When the open pull requests were listed, ISO. Present exactly with open.

more.description: At least one list was cut to its newest 50 rows.

step.description: The step it is at, or stopped at.

problem.description: Why it failed. interrupted: the process that ran it is gone and left no result.

setup.description: The setup `qcr --schema 3 host setup` started: running with the step it is at, done, or failed with the step it stopped at and why. Absent when no setup was started.

problem.description: Why it failed. attestation_rejected: the attestation on record no longer admits a go-live (it went stale, its proof is no longer the one on record, or the install is not one a host manages). interrupted: the process that ran it is gone and left no result.

label.description: With state done: how making sure of the trigger label went once the reviewer was live. ok: the label is in the repository. failed: it could not be read or created there (a token that cannot write yet, most often); the reviewer posts all the same, and a repeat `qcr --schema 3 host go-live` tries the label again and restarts nothing. Absent while nothing has tried it.

go_live.description: The go-live `qcr --schema 3 host go-live` started: done once the go-live step has succeeded, whatever the trigger label did (`label` says that, beside it). Absent when none was. Whether the reviewer posts is `posting`, the running daemon's own flag.

state.description: queued: waiting for a slot. running: a round is in flight. posting: the review is finished and being delivered to GitHub. failed: a failure is on record (problem says which). paused: queued and held by a pause.

problem.description: Why a failed row failed. retry_scheduled: the daemon retries it by itself at retry_at. posting_failed: the review could not be delivered or confirmed. round_failed: the round itself failed. worker_parked: its worker kept crashing and is parked. The last three wait for the operator.

round.description: The round in flight, or the one that failed.

started_at.description: When the round in flight started, ISO.

retry_at.description: When a retry_scheduled failure is retried, ISO.

verdict.description: What the last round decided. Not what GitHub shows: see posted_event.

posted_event.description: What the review is on GitHub as. Absent when the round posted nothing (dry-run).

approval_withheld.description: An approval was decided and is held back until the checks pass: GitHub holds a comment.

rounds.description: How many rounds the pull request has had.

findings.description: The inline comments the last round's review carries.

head_changed.description: The pull request's head moved since that round reviewed it.
